name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: J.P.Morgan global composite PMI eased to 53.2 in October from 54.3, still above 51
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI fell to 53.2 in October from 54.3 in September, its 45th month of expansion, with business optimism at a five-month low (S&P Global data via TrendForce, 4 Nov). The euro-area composite slipped to 51.7 (Borsa Italiana). The global reading remains well above the 51 Watch line.
for_you: Cooling global activity tends to show up in weaker export orders and slower hiring.

sources.title: Borsa Italiana — Unione Europea, PMI composito in ottobre

why: Purchasing-manager surveys are the fastest read on whether the world economy is expanding or contracting.
drivers: Orders, inventories, trade policy, energy costs, credit conditions.
